unit: pct of demand income per tick

cross_play.design: four pairs per world trained independently (pairs 0-1 spsa, 2-3 pg; different seeds); entry [i][j] = seat-0 individual of pair i with seat-1 individual of pair j, frozen, same noise. Gap = diagonal mean minus off-diagonal mean.

history.design: archived stages (every 10 iterations) of each lineage: a frozen round robin of the stages of one lineage (both seatings, same noise) rated with the league's Elo, and every stage against the final stage of the other lineage.

heldout.design: final individuals (frozen) against opponents that never took part in any training: one batch of matches per opponent on held-out noise; win = higher own net in the match.

audit_test_family_abm_duopoly_fx.reference: each member of the pair with a non-cooperating scripted partner (the 'compete' profile)

test_family_training_abm_duopoly_fx.note: same learners, same options as on every other family; nothing was tuned on this family
